sections.criterion: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

consistency_log.description: Objective consistency across Excellence and Implementation sections, cross-checked to Tier 3 objectives.
WP reference consistency: WP IDs cited in Excellence (methodology) and Impact (pathway grounding) match the canonical WP1-WP5 defined in Implementation.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section content wp_table_refs (Implementation WP1-WP5); Excellence 1.2 and Impact 2.2 WP references

consistency_log.description: Partner name consistency across all three sections, cross-checked to Tier 3 partners registry (ATK/HUN-REN ATK, ELTE, MATE, Krumatic, AgroVIR, MVCRI, and named individuals).
Deliverable ID consistency: D1.1-D5.2 titles and IDs referenced in Excellence, Impact and Implementation match the deliverable set.
Milestone ID consistency: milestone references MS1-MS5 used consistently between Impact and Implementation.
consistency_log.source_basis: Implementation milestone_refs MS1-MS5; Impact pathway references

consistency_log.description: KPI consistency: KPI set (K1-K11, eleven KPIs) referenced consistently within Impact; no conflicting KPI definitions or targets appear in Excellence or Implementation.
Impact claim grounding: each impact claim's cited mechanism (WP, deliverable, MVP, partner) exists in the Implementation work plan.

Budget/resource claim consistency: person-month allocations and the AgroVIR operational footprint (>745,000 ha in eight countries) are stated only in Implementation and Impact and agree; no conflicting resource figures across sections.
consistency_log.source_basis: Implementation 3.1 fellow/partner person-months and Impact 2.3/Implementation 3.2 AgroVIR footprint

consistency_log.description: Terminology consistency: key terms (DrR web MVP, crop-transfer specification, model card, blocked temporal validation, irrigation-attention output, crop-configurable architecture) used consistently across all three sections.
consistency_log.source_basis: Cross-section content comparison of canonical technical terms

consistency_log.description: Section ordering and completeness: all three criterion sections present and ordered Excellence (1), Impact (2), Implementation (3) per standard MSCA-PF/RIA Part B structure (application_forms template directory empty; standard ordering applied).
consistency_log.source_basis: Standard Part B section order; three section artifacts present

consistency_log.description: Traceability footer consistency: all three sections carry non-empty traceability_footer.primary_sources; none declares no_unsupported_claims_declaration:true while overall_status is unresolved (all three are 'assumed').

Validation status aggregation (informational): all three sections report overall_status 'assumed', reflecting operator-declared assumed items (partner acceptances, person-months, placement/access arrangements); flagged as a cross-section concern for downstream review, not a contradiction.
consistency_log.source_basis: Section validation_status.overall_status = assumed across all three

traceability_footer.derivation_note: Assembled draft inherits section-level proposal claim traceability from referenced section artifacts; this artifact adds only section index and cross-section consistency findings.
